# pleb

> Local, MIT-licensed, zero-telemetry web acquisition CLI and stdio MCP server (`pleb`) by Memory Sync Hub LLC, built to unblock `403`s and empty JS shells in Claude Code and Codex.

`pleb` routes web fetches from the host machine over Chromium 154 Cronet (or cookie-jar `reqwest` when compiled without `--features cronet`) with redirect-time SSRF protection, captures WAF/CDN diagnostic headers into typed `block_reason` envelopes, recovers from `406`/`429` mismatches, optionally signs requests with RFC 9421 Ed25519 Web Bot Auth, escalates blocks and unhydrated JS shells to offscreen CEF (`pleb-renderer`, protocol `v5-meta`) via `daemon.sock` or WebSocket CDP / Kitesurf (`--render cdp`, `--format axtree`), exposes `pleb mcp` + `pleb setup` for Claude Code and Codex, indexes WebMCP tools (`--tools`), and runs multi-provider search (`pleb search`, `pleb auth`). Active anti-bot challenges fail fast (exit code `2`) without CAPTCHA solving or evasion scripts.

## Quick Start for Agents

- **Register `pleb mcp` with Claude Code and Codex (`pleb setup`)**: run `pleb setup` (or `pleb setup --dry-run`) to wire `pleb mcp` and install [skills/pleb/SKILL.md](skills/pleb/SKILL.md).
- **Using the `pleb` CLI (`cargo install pleb && pleb skill install`)**: read [skills/pleb/SKILL.md](skills/pleb/SKILL.md) (or run `pleb skill print`) for decision trees, flags, exit codes, `block_reason`, and `pleb status --json` checks.
- **Full single-file reference**: read [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) or [README-FULL.md](README-FULL.md) for JSON output schemas, environment variables, and agent composition patterns.
- **Contributing to this repository**: read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) first for build rules, hermetic test boundaries, and non-regression gates.

## Core Documentation

- [skills/pleb/SKILL.md](skills/pleb/SKILL.md): Canonical version-locked agent skill embedded verbatim in `pleb skill print` / `pleb skill install`
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): Single-file technical reference, schemas, environment variables, and benchmark report formatted for full-context LLM ingestion
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, harness setup, verified corpus benchmark summary, tool comparison, installation, and quick start
- [README-FULL.md](README-FULL.md): Complete CLI & MCP reference, five-stage extraction pipeline, environment variables, JSON output schemas, comparison matrix, and packaging notes
- [examples/corpus_benchmark.rs](examples/corpus_benchmark.rs): Reproducible corpus byte/token reduction and extraction throughput harness

## Packaging and Distribution

- [Cargo.toml](Cargo.toml): Cargo crate manifest (`pleb`, default `reqwest` TLS with `cookies` or optional `cronet` feature)
- [packaging/homebrew/pleb.rb](packaging/homebrew/pleb.rb): Homebrew formula template for tap distribution
- [scripts/download-cronet-macos.sh](scripts/download-cronet-macos.sh): macOS arm64 prebuilt Chromium 154 `libcronet.a` downloader
- [scripts/download-cronet-linux.sh](scripts/download-cronet-linux.sh): Linux `x86_64` / `aarch64` prebuilt Chromium 154 `libcronet.so` downloader
- [scripts/install-cef-mac.sh](scripts/install-cef-mac.sh): macOS arm64 offscreen CEF `v5-meta` installer
- [scripts/install-cef-linux.sh](scripts/install-cef-linux.sh): Linux `x86_64` / `aarch64` native Ozone headless CEF `v5-meta` installer
- [scripts/install-skill.sh](scripts/install-skill.sh): Symlinks `skills/pleb` from a source checkout into local agent skill directories

## Engineering Rules

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Build rules, host installation sync, hermetic test boundaries, and non-regression gates
- [data/site-rules.json](data/site-rules.json): Bundled host rewrite and mandatory CEF overrides
- [tests/corpus_evaluation.rs](tests/corpus_evaluation.rs): Corpus non-regression test harness across all `45` fixtures
- [tests/unblock_canary_tests.rs](tests/unblock_canary_tests.rs): Hermetic block-diagnostic tests and opt-in live harness-403 unblock canary
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT license and upstream attribution (`wickproject/wick`)

## Historical Milestone Specifications

The documents in `docs/` capture point-in-time design decisions from Milestones 1–6 (including pre-rename development notes and earlier Keychain/protocol layouts). Treat [README-FULL.md](README-FULL.md), [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt), [skills/pleb/SKILL.md](skills/pleb/SKILL.md), and `src/` as authoritative for the current CLI and library contract.

- [docs/01-transport-daemon-and-batch-fetch.md](docs/01-transport-daemon-and-batch-fetch.md): Historical design record for Milestones 1–2 (extraction pipeline, transport daemon, batch fetch)
- [docs/02-swarm-hillclimb-protocol.md](docs/02-swarm-hillclimb-protocol.md): Swarm convergence protocol, Generator–Verifier separation, and subtraction gates
- [docs/03-structured-source-negotiation.md](docs/03-structured-source-negotiation.md): Milestone 3 design record (raw-source resolution, Markdown mirrors, feeds, native Markdown)
- [docs/04-resource-indexing-and-staging.md](docs/04-resource-indexing-and-staging.md): Milestone 4 design record (resource salience indexing, SVG/transcript rescue, artifact staging)
- [docs/05-multi-provider-search-and-auth.md](docs/05-multi-provider-search-and-auth.md): Milestone 5 design record (`auth` credential storage and multi-provider search routing)
- [docs/06-agent-identity-webmcp-and-cdp-renderer.md](docs/06-agent-identity-webmcp-and-cdp-renderer.md): Milestone 6 design record (RFC 9421 Web Bot Auth, WebMCP indexing, CDP / Kitesurf transport)
